bootstrap.scope: paired test-speaker uncertainty for fixed models and thresholds; excludes training, calibration and text resampling; no multiple-comparison adjustment

config.calibration: validation normal only, separately by model and policy; also report unchanged original five-vowel thresholds
config.phone_support: unchanged split-specific universally registered trained phones; use all available supported phones, identically for all claims
config.primary_comparison: equal/vowels4 minus equal/vowels5; validation-normal calibrated FAR1pct; full-input FAR and FRR
config.secondary_comparisons: mixed-phone policy and all three frozen clean Transformer seeds; no test-based model or policy selection
